#### What type of PR is this?

Add one of the following kinds:
/kind bug

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind failing-test

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Fixes an issue added in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/101895 where metrics were only fetched once, `sync.Once` only wraps the part that checks that the required pods are in a ready state, next calls will skip checking that the required pods are in a ready state.

Ref: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/102865

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

cc @jingxu97

The sync.Once function are used for waiting for the corresponding pods once, 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/88982

I think it is a mistake, and the logic to obtain metrics should be out of the sync.Once function
```
			output, lastMetricsFetchErr = g.getSecureMetricsFromPod(g.kubeControllerManager, metav1.NamespaceSystem, kubeControllerManagerPort)
```
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/101895#commitcomment-50902953

review_comments:
we should keep the ReadyOnce but only with
```
		if readyErr := e2epod.WaitForPodsReady(g.client, metav1.NamespaceSystem, podName, 0); readyErr != nil {
```
inside.
And move the 
```
			output, lastMetricsFetchErr = g.getSecureMetricsFromPod(g.kubeControllerManager, metav1.NamespaceSystem, kubeControllerManagerPort)
```
out of the sync.Once

thanks, I moved the `WaitForPodsReady` request to be inside `sync.Once` however I kept the PollImmediate to make the call to get stats from the desired pod.

I was hesitant to add

```
			output, lastMetricsFetchErr = g.getSecureMetricsFromPod(g.kubeControllerManager, metav1.NamespaceSystem, kubeControllerManagerPort)
```

without a retry function because there's the chance that the request fails.
